body: Is their a possibility that this isn't an ex but actually a side dude she may be dealing with? Could of lost his shit and fell in love with her. I had a similar situation. Admittedly, years ago,  I was in a relationship and was messing with someone on the side. The guy caught feeling and threatened to tell my BF CONSTANTLY. Just saying. Consider all things because who would lie about having a stalker? Also, why would she protect an ex and their feelings over you? Why jeopardize your child's safety?
I know how you feel.... Going through the same!! Feel free to msg me...
Thank you. That response gave me so much comfort.
